output_format.description: The output format for the analysis results. Supported values are 'xml' or 'json'.

output_file.description: The path to the output file. If empty or omitted, output is written to stdout.

compressed_output.description: If true, the output file will be compressed using zip format. Only applies when output_file is specified.

numeric_timestamps.description: If true, timestamps in the output will be numeric (epoch) instead of human-readable strings. Useful for JSON/XML parsing.

tab_delimiter.description: The delimiter character to use if the output format is tab-separated (legacy mode). Default is tab.

input_type.description: Specifies whether the input is a single INF2 file ('file') or a directory containing recycle bin data ('directory').

input_path.description: The path to the input .INF2 file or the directory to analyze.

input_codepage.description: The character encoding codepage to use for parsing filenames in legacy INF2 files (e.g., 'cp1252', 'utf8').
